---
title: "National security looms large for foreign investment"
date: "2021-04-20"
categories: ["Foreign Investment"]
---

I have an op-ed in [The Mandarin](https://www.themandarin.com.au/154385-national-security-looms-large-for-foreign-investment/) arguing that the government needs to articulate clearly and transparently the reasons for rejecting foreign acquisitions to minimise foreign investment uncertainty and its economic effects.
